Still Warm.descriptor: The box is open and the donuts are still warm. This is not a drill.
This is the moment of peak donut perfection. Drop what you're doing.
That sweet, sugary aroma is the smell of a truly great morning.

Prime Selection.descriptor: All varieties are still available. Sprinkles, glazed, jelly-filled... the choice is yours.
Word is spreading. The window for a premium choice is closing fast.
They may have cooled, but they are still at the peak of their flavor.

Only Plain Left.descriptor: All the frosted and filled donuts have been claimed. Only the plain remain.
It's this or the questionable yogurt in the back of the fridge.
A plain donut is better than no donut. Probably.

Halfsies & Crumbs.descriptor: People have resorted to cutting donuts in half. It's chaos.
The box is a crime scene of crumbs, stray sprinkles, and regret.
Only a sad, bisected remnant of a Boston Cream remains.

Just a Sad, Empty Box.descriptor: The box is empty, serving only as a monument to what once was.
Someone needs to do the right thing and throw this empty box away.
You missed it. Better luck next time.
